claim: The new Help item says 'text inside a form drawn more than once, cannot be edited.' That is false. Per §9.2, a run in a Form drawn twice scans as candidate with cowable true. The Text panel labels it 'Editable (this placement only)' (renderer.ts:4463), and a Text panel edit rewrites that one placement. The run only lacks an on-page target (bounds null). tests/p2-shell.test.mjs:217 pins the false sentence.

fix: index.html:569 → 'Text placed exactly on top of the same text cannot be edited; text inside a form drawn more than once has no on-page target (edit it from the Text panel, this placement only).' Update the p2-shell.test.mjs:217 pin to match.

clause: contract preamble (the human's report 'text I add is no longer editable'); §9.14 defers it
claim: A run added in the GUI cannot grow, because its growth limit is its own right edge. Typing 'Twin 2' into an added 'Twin' is refused as overflow even though about 280 pt to the right is free. The user sees 'The replacement exceeds the available free space.' So for the common edit (adding characters), added text still looks not editable. This is pre-U8 and deferred to §10, but it is the same complaint U8 was meant to fix.
reproduction: Run .quad/shared/p6/checks/review-u8-renderer-probe.mjs with real CDP clicks: add Twin at (300,300), click (312,304), select, insertText 'Twin 2', Meta+Enter → refused [{text Twin, detail overflow}], revision stays 2. Result is in review-out/review-u8-renderer-probe.json commitTwin2; screenshot review-u8-r4-after-twin2.png.
fix: DEFERRED by fable51 to progress.md §10 (pre-existing growth limit for app-written runs; a later unit). No change in U8.

clause: §0 STATE truthful / no silent failure; integration open defect 2
claim: Sequence: add text, undo, then add via the Text panel. The revision goes up by 1 and the status says 'Added text', but content.lastAdd is {targetId '', bounds null}, direct.targets does not change, and the run is drawn in a fallback serif font (the dangling /PDF4AllF1). The renderer says nothing about it because renderer.ts:3958 only announces when targetId !== ''. Result: the added text silently cannot be edited.
reproduction: In review-u8-renderer-probe.mjs, after 4 real #undo clicks to revision 8, Text panel Add 'Solo' → panelAdd1 {rev 9, targets 5, lastAdd {targetId '', bounds null}, status 'Added text'}. Screenshot review-u8-r8-overprint.png shows 'Solo' in a serif font with no outline.
fix: Renderer only (fable51's call): at renderer.ts:3958 also announce when contentLastAdd.targetId === '' ('Added text is not editable on the page') and pin the string in tests/p2-shell.test.mjs (src.includes). The engine font bug after undo is pre-existing in engine.ts (untouched by U8) and goes to progress.md §10.
